garden_source: Garden v15.2 + SCEP v1.1 merged candidate (2026-09-12)
title: Minimal GSL-KR claim/evidence/dependency store
objective: Implement a local persistent store for claims, evidence, epistemic states, dependencies, corrections, counterexamples, and supersession without laundering assertions into truth.
acceptance: Storage/retrieval/repetition cannot upgrade epistemic status without an explicit admitted evidence transition.
